fieldNotes.siteIdentity: The supplied coords (27.264795, -82.486424) land on the Publix building, the grey+tan-roofed DC on the WEST side of the Palmer Ranch / Sawyer Rd industrial parcel. The much larger bright-white building immediately to the EAST (across a tree-lined drainage corridor) is a SEPARATE, larger distribution facility on its own parcel and is NOT part of this audit. Confirmed via Yelp/YellowPages/TruckMap listings for 'Publix Sarasota Warehouse, 6123 Sawyer Rd' and by satellite z16-z21.
fieldNotes.coords: Pinned to the centroid of the Publix building (two-tone roof: tan/concrete north half, grey south half), ~27.2643,-82.48635.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property is fully perimeter-fenced (chain-link + hedge) on every public frontage. Street View along Sawyer Rd (west) and the north access road shows continuous fence with NO open driveway and No-Parking signage; trucks were seen staged bumper-to-bumper ON the public access road (pano 7ugekUmvXEaSpyBkJVJKBw, 2023-04, shows a queued red tractor + trailers). The single combined vehicle entrance is a private drive entering from the SW (off the Palmer Ranch collector). Google Street View has no on-property coverage past the fence line, and every roadside pano snapped to the public street, which itself indicates a controlled, set-back private entrance — i.e. a truck gate exists.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Could not positively resolve a guard booth from overhead imagery at the set-back entrance throat, and there is no Street View coverage of the gate itself. No clear ~1-3-vehicle booth structure was visible beside the drive in z20/z21 satellite. Marked guardShack=false / remoteGs=true (gate present, no confirmed manned booth -> kiosk/call-box/app check-in implied). Both flags listed as uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true because a controlled gate is present but no manned guard shack could be confirmed; low-medium confidence.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks visibly stage/queue on the public access road outside the gate (Street View 2023-04), and there is paved width outside the entrance throat -> pre-gate staging true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large deep paved yard inside the fence between the entrance drive and the dock faces; ample room to hold queued trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The internal approach from the gate to the dock faces, plus the deep south apron and north drop-yard drive, easily holds 3+ trucks; long.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate is on a private set-back drive with a deep internal yard and an undeveloped wooded buffer between the property and the nearest public road; a gate queue would not spill onto a through road. Not backup-sensitive.
fieldNotes.entryLanes/exitLanes: Single combined entrance drive observed; entry/exit through one point. Exact lane count not visible at the set-back gate -> estimated 1 in / 1 out, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: No evidence of a wide multi-lane gate apron or 3+ lanes at the single set-back entrance; false.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock-door bands read on the building's SOUTH face (long striped dock line with trailers backed in, ~27.2631) and along the WEST face (reefer trailers backed in); combined estimate ~55 doors -> band 50+. Exact count uncertain where dock lines run under roof shadow.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop yard north of the building with two long parallel rows of parked trailers (z19 nyard imagery), plus a long staged trailer row along the north/west drive; ~70 trailers visible, capacity ~110 -> band 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Docks read on two distinct building faces (south face dock bank + west face dock bank) suggesting physically separate ship/receive clusters; set true but flagged uncertain (single connected building, faces could serve one mixed operation).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site sits inside the dense built-up south Sarasota / Palmer Ranch fabric: bounded by large residential subdivisions (S, W), a Clark Rd commercial strip (N), and a neighboring large DC + industrial park (E). This is metro-area dense development, not edge-of-town -> Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Dense suburban metro setting with abundant nearby development; cellular coverage is not a concern. False.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Only ONE large building cluster belongs to this Publix parcel (main DC + attached SW fleet-maintenance annex). The adjacent white mega-DC to the east is a separate property, so multipleFacilities=false. buildingCount=2 counts the main DC + the small SW annex/maintenance shop.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path in z20/z21 imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest activity is roadway only. False.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: 2 = main Publix DC building + a small detached fleet/maintenance annex with canopies at the SW corner (green bobtail tractors/vans visible).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~55 acres derived (shoelace) from the traced perimeter polygon (fenced parcel incl. drop yard, building, apron, parking, and retention/buffer inside the fence).
